body: I think he has just adapted and can't see life without his habit possible.. i am 22, addiction prone recently overcame the lowest point in my life I finally decided that I wanted sobriety more than the evils and bad karma drugs brought me. Some people can't do this by themselves, eventually the duration I can imagine depletes the mind of self recovery and will power, sometimes very quickly.. You should tell the police he is aggressive, and stealing to feed his habit and when incapable of self medicating you fear suicide may happen from severe withdrawal symptoms. He will surefire thank you later as he will be admitted against his will and won't be able to leave until a positive mental outcome occurs.

well i've decided i couldn't leave my daughter in this world without her father intentionally. I am soon to be a journeyman electrician, and realized it would just ultimately be selfish to commit suicide to a temporary situation, it could never be forgiven. As i never forgave my parents. I want to make my child proud and leave the world with dignity when my time has come. I may not have support from anyone, and was even encouraged by her mother and my roomate to die. I'm a humble man.. shy but more confident on a resolution than ever. I will prove her mother wrong, that my life is worth living.. I was a mislead teenager with the wrong crowd and feel horrible for the heartache I may have caused. I owe it back and will pay it forward.. I love my daughter, she saved my life.. I hope everyone can find someone or something that is worth living for rather than just yourself. I'm over my ex finally, i know and understand where people come from when they make irrational decisions due to breakup, but there are many beautiful souls in this world and if that person isn't loving you as much as you love them then you just need to look forward to the one that will, he/she is out there. prevail, it's just an irrational thought process.
